source: User requested self-designed 20-session main arc after ~5-year leap but stopped the leap explicitly before execution
skip_gate: Authorized in direct player instruction: five-year time skip executed from 1278-09-19 to 1283-09-19. Stop at first personally observed event 1283-09-19 07:23 in Kusa hospital.
premise: Years after Konoha invasion, border medicine and public safety clash over covert graft research. A network saved some people while exploiting others. Old tissue-compatibility registry is evidence and leverage, not proof Shiki's anomaly was engineered.
setting_rules: No Otsutsuki/Kaguya, godlike city-destroying abilities, infinite chakra or guaranteed DNA assimilation
Physiological treatments take time and have consequences; Shiki's Zero Genome self-limited by mastery
NPC autonomy, independent motives, bounded knowledge, witness-gated acquisition; NEVER show offscreen GM-only scenes as player-known
Causal branching: player agency, no forced Shiki thoughts, speech, consent, life choices or moral stance

Age 20 Shiki and five-year jump make Part I/Shippuden chronological divergences: do not assume canon plot scene sequence or outcomes blindly; adjudicate live world from exam invasion and five elapsed years, protect already played outcomes.

Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha, Gaara, Sakura Haruno, Kakashi, Tsunade and canon factions have their own initiatives and conflicting knowledge; no forced cameos, no plot armor, no predetermined encounters.
No offscreen scenes in player-facing narrative: only Shiki's real sensory experience or verifiable reports.

canon_world_integration.real_connection_rule: Every act must include at least one substantial cross-village consequence that changes choices, security, medical resources or who can travel. At least 2 distinct Naruto-era powers actively pursue their OWN goals in each five-session act. Named Naruto actors appear in person ONLY if personal proximity and timing plausibly place them there; otherwise show indirect effects through actual source Shiki receives. No lore name-dropping only.
canon_world_integration.privacy_rule: Information about Haku and Hozuki samples remains known to Shiki only unless an actor obtains its own evidence, even when Kiri launches archive audit. No offscreen NPC narrative, no Shinobi omniscience.
canon_world_integration.alternate_chronology: The 1283 world is an alternate five-year continuation from 1278 exam and death of Third Hokage; Shippuden's exact manga timeline is not automatically transferred. Tsunade and Gaara governmental status require internally grounded historical development before NPC references.

pacing_directive_2026_11_13.source: Direct player GM note: «Мастеру: внеси поправки в инструкции, я хочу больше экшена, не готов играть в детектив, расследование Окей, но должен быть экшен и продолжи сцену»
pacing_directive_2026_11_13.priority: Overrules lower-priority detective-dominant staging; does NOT overwrite prior played events or NPC private motives.
pacing_directive_2026_11_13.campaign_mode: Dark, high-intensity Naruto tactical/action adventure with inquiry as plot catalyst and evidence trail, not investigative bureaucracy as core gameplay.
execute: Immediate transition from Ivovy Brod medical administrative pause to causally grounded armed hostile initiative or environmental emergency with genuine tactical window; no NPC acting on offscreen knowledge they cannot have.

Broader Act1 game loops: operational raids/counter-raids, escort combat and medical triage under threat, infiltration, pursuit, field counterintelligence; forensic tasks delegated to Izumi/Seina and delivered as concise consequences when Shiki returns.
Scene tempo escalates in 1–2 quiet beats, then delivers actual changed stakes and a decision in the face of danger; accelerate travel and paperwork to missions, don't burn 5 turns per dossier.
NPC attackers may fight local guards, steal evidence or hinder rescue without targeting Shiki by plot requirement; adversaries have limited perception and retreat plans, not omniscience.

Give clear visible threat data: range, terrain, posture, sensory warning, projectile/technique bearing, time window and endangered targets. No forced auto-defenses/attacks/choice of techniques for Shiki. NPC allies act independently and can sustain injuries.

Use current 1283 aged20 Shiki skill sheet, not old 1278 Genin stats. Legitimate risk from surprise, combined arms, civilian harm, constraints on power, and competing objectives, not nerf or narrative plot armor.
Hard POV gate and medical plausibility unchanged; maintain Shiki's unusual presence by differentiated NPC body language in action, not repetitive 'everyone afraid'.
Treat investigative twist evidence as reward for field choices and aftermath, not constant interrogations.
pacing_directive_2026_11_13.arc1: Act1 may conclude on the scale of several strong operational crises rather than five paperwork-centric sessions; not all time needs manual play. Keep broad canon faction/world arcs independent and causal.
